source:
@@U04562@@
treasure gives him no pleasure.
Sadness, gladness are a whim,
he starves amidst his plenty,
and pain and rapture are both postponed,
for only the future has his interest,
and nothing is ever accomplished.

@@U04564@@
Stop!
Youll never get to me that way!
I won't hear such nonsense!
Leave here!
This litany of yours
might deceive the wisest of men!
It won't deceive me!

@@U04566@@
Shall he go? Shall he come?
He simply can’t make up his mind.
Midway in the beaten path
he gropes and staggers, step at a time,
growing ever more confused,
sees the world about him whirling,
a burden to himself and others,
who, breathing, takes a breath and smothers;
no, not smothers, not quite dead yet.
Never yielding nor despairing,
he rolls on down his endless incline,
resigning everything delightful,
doing what he deathly hates,
sleeping badly, badly waking,
pinned to the spot that makes him ready
to suffer eternal hellish perdition.

@@U04568@@
Cursed specters!
This is how you've treated the human race
time out of mind! Even indifferent days
you turn into tangles of ensnaring torment!
translation:
@@U04562@@
财宝不会给他带来快乐。
悲伤、快乐都是一时兴起，
他在富足中却挨饿，
痛苦和狂喜都被推迟，
因为他只关心未来，
但什么也没有完成。

@@U04564@@
停下来！
你永远不会那样接近我！
我不会听这样的废话！
离开这里！
你的这一连串
可能会欺骗最聪明的人！
它不会骗我的！

@@U04566@@
他要走吗？他会来吗？
他就是拿不定主意。
走在老路的中途
他摸索着，摇摇晃晃，一步一步，
越来越迷茫，
看到他周围的世界旋转，
给自己和他人带来负担，
他呼吸着，呼吸着，窒息了；
不，没有窒息，还没有完全死掉。
永不屈服，也不绝望，
他沿着无尽的斜坡滚下去，
放弃一切美好的事物，
做着他极其厌恶的事情，
睡得不好，醒得不好，
固定在让他做好准备的地方
遭受永远地狱般的灭亡。

@@U04568@@
被诅咒的幽灵！
这就是你们对待人类的方式
时间没脑子！就算是无动于衷的日子
你变成了纠缠折磨的纠缠！
